trial_court: Court of Swati Gupta-I, ACJ-Cum-ARC-Cum-CCJ, New Delhi District, Patiala House Courts, New Delhi, Succession Case No. 41/2016 (old no. 2/13)
case_name: Sushma Devi Ors vs State on 26 September, 2023

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Sushma W/o Sh. Naresh Kumar, Sh. Vinay Kumar @ Rohit S/o Sh. Naresh Kumar, Ms. Nisha D/o Sh. Naresh Kumar
parties.respondent_defendant: State, through its Director L.H.M.C. & S.K. Hospital New Delhi-1 under Govt. of India, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Director General of Health Service, Smt. Bimlesh

facts_of_case: Petitioners are the legal heirs of deceased Late Sh. Naresh Kumar and have applied for succession certificate under Section 372 of the Indian Succession Act, 1925 in respect of debts/securities of the deceased.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party claiming to be a legally wedded wife/widow to prove their claim.
legal_principles.held: In this regard, it is relevant to note that petitioner no. 1 has proved certified copy of decree of divorce between the deceased late Sh. Naresh Kumar and respondent no.2 as Ex. PW1/14.

legal_principles.principle: A decree of divorce is conclusive evidence of the dissolution of marriage.
legal_principles.held: As per the same, the marriage between the parties thereto was dissolved u/s. 13 (1)(ia) of Hindu Marriage Act.

outcome.result: Allowed in favour of petitioner No. 3
outcome.final_order: Petitioner No. 3's petition for grant of succession certificate was allowed.

use_for_drafting: drafting divorce petition under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
advising on grounds for divorce under Section 13
assisting in obtaining succession certificate under Section 372
